## Summary

I've successfully implemented the chore to fix the OnboardingStyle cards to match the exact design specifications. Here's what was completed:

### Changes Made:

1. ✅ **Removed duplicate labels** - Verified that there are NO duplicate style name labels appearing above or on the image area. Only the title appears below the image in the card content section.

2. ✅ **Maintained black title color** - Confirmed the style titles ("Minimal · Timeless", "Luxury · Elegant", etc.) remain in BLACK (`text-gray-900`), which matches the reference design images.

3. ✅ **Removed description truncation** - Removed the `line-clamp-3` class from the description paragraph (line 150) to allow full description text to display without ellipsis truncation.

4. ✅ **Removed fixed card height** - Removed the `h-[320px]` constraint from the card button and the `h-[100px]` constraint from the card content div to allow the card to grow dynamically based on description length.

5. ✅ **Verified border consistency** - Confirmed soft rose border (#E8D5D5) is properly applied via CSS variables (`--onboarding-card-border` and `--onboarding-card-border-selected`).

### Key Code Changes:

- **Line 119**: Removed `h-[320px]` from card button to allow dynamic height
- **Line 142**: Removed `h-[100px]` from card content div
- **Line 150**: Removed `line-clamp-3` class from description paragraph
